$comment: When to use each button variant. The component itself is src/styles/components/button.css, built from Figma "Foundation – UI 2" (Buttons, node 18:3529; component set 23:5203). Also covers Icon Button (node 23:5380; component set 23:5345, src/styles/components/icon-button.css) under "iconButton". Shown on the Buttons and Icon Buttons pages and published to public/llms.txt by `npm run tokens`.
intro: Buttons let users initiate an action, acknowledge something, make a choice, or navigate. By default, our buttons are 24px tall, come in two styles (primary and secondary), and can optionally include an icon in front and in back.
rules: Use a <button class="button button--<variant>"> for actions and an <a class="button button--<variant>"> for navigation; never style a <div> as a button.
Use one primary button per view or panel; pair it with secondary buttons for the other actions.
Disable with the disabled attribute on <button> or aria-disabled="true" on links; every variant then shares the same disabled look.
Write labels as short verbs (Save, Delete, Continue), not "OK" or "Click here".

Icons are 16px Icon Shells (<svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-<name>"></use></svg>) before or after the label; the button sizes them and they take the label's color. Icon-only actions use an Icon Button.

variants.label: Primary
variants.usage: The main action in a view, e.g. Save or Continue. Use one per view or panel.

variants.label: Secondary
variants.usage: Supporting actions next to a primary button, e.g. Cancel or Back.

variants.label: Tertiary
variants.usage: Low-emphasis actions in toolbars, lists and dense UI, where a fill would add noise.

variants.label: Danger
variants.usage: Destructive actions that can't easily be undone, e.g. Delete. Confirm before acting.

variants.label: Success
variants.usage: Positive, confirming actions, e.g. Approve or Publish.

iconButton.intro: Icon buttons trigger an action with an icon alone, for compact toolbars and actions repeated on every row. They are 24px square, have no fill until hovered, and show an active fill while pressed or switched on.

states.label: Active
states.usage: --color-bg-pressed fill while pressed, or while a toggle is on (aria-pressed="true").

states.label: Disabled
states.usage: No fill and a dimmed icon; set the disabled attribute.

rules: Use <button class="icon-button" type="button" aria-label="…"> containing one Icon Shell (<svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-<name>"></use></svg>); the button sizes it to 16px.
Always give it an aria-label (and a matching title for a tooltip) — the icon alone has no accessible name.
Use only icons whose meaning is clear without a label; otherwise use a Button with an icon and text.
For on/off actions (e.g. Bold, Pin), toggle aria-pressed; the Active fill then shows the on state.
